description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a shallow white square base and a separate white rectangular leg piece lying nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the leg as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it forward and slightly left into the base’s corner, then presses it down to seat it while the left hand hovers near the base without touching; the right hand then releases, leaving the leg standing upright in the base.
